status.principle: terminal state is derived from tracked-mutation checks, canary failures, command classification, and invocation freeze.

preconditions_checked.principle: records the before-edit snapshot, dirty worktree, tracked hashes, roadmap declarations, resolver env, boundaries, and protected files.

scope_boundary_and_repository_wide_closu.principle: qualifies only Exp6169-Exp6182 and records repository-wide closure as bare false.

v535_task_writer_census.principle: lists only declared .535 task writer/test surfaces keyed by task, module, mechanism, and exact path.

frozen_canary_module_and_invocation_mani.principle: freezes the command contract downstream .535 tasks can reuse.

canonical_resolver_and_legacy_compatibil.principle: shows canonical, legacy literal, atomic, checkpoint, and subprocess paths under the temp root.

task_owned_temp_root_receipts.principle: proves the canary installed a validated task-owned temporary artifact root.

collection_and_subprocess_receipts.principle: keeps command and subprocess receipts auditable without implying repo-wide closure.

attempted_tracked_write_controls.principle: records a real tracked write attempt caught before bytes changed.

traversal_symlink_workspace_root_and_ato.principle: records escape, invalid-root, and atomic-cleanup controls.

tracked_result_hash_before_after_matrix.principle: compares aggregate and sentinel tracked-result hashes before and after canary controls.

quarantine_field_before_after_matrix.principle: compares protected quarantine/corrigendum/provenance fields before and after redirected writes.

canary_failure_classification.principle: classifies nonzero commands as canary-scope, unrelated pre-existing, new regression, or unclassified.

isolation_violation_count.principle: counts tracked mutations and canary-scope failures.

v535_task_artifact_isolation_ready_score.principle: one only with zero mutations, zero canary-scope failures, frozen invocation, and classified nonzero commands.

preexisting_worktree_changes_preserved.principle: records that pre-existing dirty paths were observed and not reverted or staged by this workflow.

protected_files_unchanged.principle: proves protected operational and guard files did not change during the canary run.

inference_substrate.principle: declares deterministic task-scoped repository test isolation.

field_provenance.principle: maps every required field to its source and principle.

test_commands.principle: records commands used to verify the canary.

test_exit_codes.principle: records exit codes for the verification commands.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: hashes the artifact content excluding the checksum field.

honest_verdict.principle: terminal verdict names the exact qualified scope without repository-wide closure.

honest_verdict: complete_partial: Exp6169-Exp6182 declared .535 canary surface ready_score=0, isolation_violation_count=1, repository_wide_closure_claimed=false.
